instruction: Configure VS Code to automatically format files when saving.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling format on save in VS Code. Evaluator verifies that the settings.json file contains editor.formatOnSave set to true. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the VS Code settings.json file from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric check_json_settings properly verifies that editor.formatOnSave is set to true
Expected value structure is correct: when type='rule', get_rule returns config['rules'] which becomes {'expected': {'editor.formatOnSave': true}}
Complete coverage: The instruction requires enabling format-on-save, and the evaluator checks the exact VS Code setting that controls this feature
Semantic correctness: editor.formatOnSave is the official VS Code setting for auto-formatting on save
No postconfig needed: VS Code settings.json persists to disk automatically
Proper data flow: getter extracts file -> metric loads JSON -> checks for expected key-value pair

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
